definition: Solve the plan on the bench again from its record, then run corrective rounds on what the critic finds before the sheet is drawn. A placement the solver proved should come back the same; one from the fast search may differ run to run.
basis: Our wording of an explicit solve. docs/revise.md: "an explicit solve runs one or two corrective rounds before the plan is surfaced", while "the WALL DRAG sends none, because a gesture cannot wait for a loop any more than it can wait" for a proof.
